items.description: Compensation for robbery damage (watch and cash)
items.rationale: Indemnified under 2.3.1, 4.2.2, 4.2.3, 4.2.4, 7.1.1, 7.1.5, 7.1.10: Watch is a valuable (sub-limit EUR 2,500 per item, no schedule), cash is means of payment (sub-limit EUR 500), both taken by force outside the insured premises (overall EUR 5,000 sub-limit applies, but valuables and means-of-payment sub-limits are lower and thus operative). Deductible EUR 50 applies once per event.
Excluded by 7.1.8(b): carriage, shipping, delivery and comparable charges are not indemnified, even if raised alongside an indemnifiable benefit.
